name: target_construction_integrity
purpose: Verify alternative labels/targets are constructible and match semantics.
pass_signal: No missing/invalid targets; target distribution documented.

name: fold_leakage_guard
purpose: Verify no held-out subject leakage or pair leakage.
pass_signal: No subject overlap; no row/pair overlap across train/test.

name: retention_balance_audit
purpose: Verify enough usable data remains after alternative target rules.
pass_signal: Retention and class/target balance exceed spec thresholds.

name: trivial_baseline_control
purpose: Verify the task is not solved by trivial subject/fold artifacts.
pass_signal: Trivial/no-training controls are reported and do not create false confidence.

name: metric_sanity_control
purpose: Verify chosen metrics respond to known synthetic or baseline cases.
pass_signal: Primary and secondary metrics behave consistently with target semantics.
